name: a gradient mark and wordmark settle with a launch date
looks: A small dated tag fades in above a short line naming when the product launched. A gradient-coloured mark and the wordmark beside it settle together below, static and calm on a near-black field.
build: The dated tag and launch line fade/rise in first; the mark and wordmark fade/scale in together (0.92 -> 1, power3.out) a beat later, holding still for the rest of the shot.
sound: A soft low swell under the hold and a light confirm tone as the mark lands.
prompt: Fade in a small dated tag above a line naming when the product launched, then settle a gradient-coloured mark and wordmark together beneath it on a near-black field, calm and still, as a brief look back before the numbers arrive.
